meta.title: Skill selector
meta.description: Find all effective skills by task in the current conversation’s right pane. Show all purpose matches without a recommendation or comparison count limit; use one, combine a primary skill with helpers and duties through a preview, or compare separate trials. Combined reviews do not affect individual skill scores. Favorites, hidden skills and reviews are retained. Includes full YouMind and the original Cookbook and PromptFill sites, opened in new Chrome windows after selection. Hiding never deletes or globally disables skills.
